class NestedIterator:
    def __init__(self, nestedList: [NestedInteger]):
        def dfs(ls):
            for x in ls:
                if x.isInteger():
                    self.nums.append(x.getInteger())
                else:
                    dfs(x.getList())

        self.nums = []
        self.i = -1
        dfs(nestedList)

    def next(self) -> int:
        self.i += 1
        return self.nums[self.i]

    def hasNext(self) -> bool:
        return self.i + 1 < len(self.nums)
